about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Nancy Pelosi

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SPEAKING OUT FOR FREEDOM
statements.title: SPEAKING OUT FOR FREEDOM
sentences: The most horrible form of torture that the Chinese have over these people is to tell them that nobody remembers you or why you are here.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
statements.title: UKRAINE SUPPORT ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I thank the distinguished once and future chair of the Committee on Foreign Affairs for his steadfast leadership and determination for the people of Ukraine.

I rise today in strong support of the Ukraine Support Act and thank Leader Hoyer for his persistence and his determination to bring this legislation to the floor and, of course, Marcy, who has been our inspiration, Marcy Kaptur.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT THE PRESIDENT SHOULD PRIORITIZE SECURING THE RELEASE OF PASTOR JIN MINGRI, PASTOR GAO QUANFU AND HIS WIFE
statements.title: EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT THE PRESIDENT SHOULD PRIORITIZE SECURING THE RELEASE OF PASTOR JIN MINGRI, PASTOR GAO QUANFU AND HIS WIFE PANG YU, DR. GULSHAN ABBAS, AND...
sentences: They say that these autocrats--the President of China for one--the most horrible form of torture that they can put on a prisoner is to tell them nobody even remembers them or cares about them or even knows why they are in prison.
Now they have a grandbaby in the family, and Jimmy, of course, is not able to see the baby while they torture him in prison.

I rise today in strong support of this resolution calling on the President to prioritize the release of these courageous individuals who have been unjustly detained by the government of the People's Republic of China simply for exercising their fundamental human rights.
I thank Johnny O, and I urge a strong bipartisan vote in support of the resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT, PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION, TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITH IRAN
sentences: The President said we can't do childcare because we have to spend money on war.

I urge our colleagues to respect who they are, Members of Congress with the power to declare war, and insist on voting on this motion put forth by the distinguished, soon-to-be-chairman-again of the Foreign Affairs Committee, Mr. Meeks.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPU
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: The other is whether Iran should have a nuclear weapon, which everyone agrees they should not, but that doesn't mean the Constitution of the United States should be a casualty of that because the administration wants to take a shortcut to the war.
Again, everyone agrees Iran should not have a nuclear weapon.
He was masterful in diplomacy and in forging an agreement that verifiably prevented Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon.
I urge my colleagues to vote in support of the Constitution and then go on to the debate of whether we should go into Iran or how we go into Iran.
I urge my colleagues to honor your oath of office, honor the vision of our Founders, and honor the sacrifice of our men and women in uniform who have gotten us here today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: The Affordable Care Act, proudly also known as ObamaCare, is a pillar of health and financial security for America's working families.

Today, we vote on Leader Jeffries' clear, commonsense, and urgent bill to extend the ACA tax credits signed into law by President Biden so healthcare remains affordable and accessible for the American people.
Parents saying: My baby was born with a heart condition costing millions of dollars before the Affordable Care Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all of my colleagues to vote ``yes'' and support this bill to protect healthcare and the dignity of America's working families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LIBERTY VERSUS TYRANNY
statements.title: LIBERTY VERSUS TYRANNY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I salute Marcy Kaptur and the Ukrainian Caucus for inviting Members to come together to raise concerns, to speak frankly about the need for strong sanctions on Russia, and to insist that any peace must be just, durable, and centered on the Ukrainian people themselves.
Mr. Speaker, for nearly 4 years, the people of Ukraine have stood on the front lines for freedom, defending their democracy, their sovereignty, and their right to live in peace on their own land.
In the conversation about peace, we hear people talk about Ukraine giving up land.
What we are saying to Ukraine is that Russia came in, stole their children, as Congresswoman Kaptur mentioned, tens of thousands of their children.
I don't think people realize that 90 percent of the security that we send to Ukraine is spent--of the 100 percent, 90 percent is spent in the United States, creating jobs in our country.
Across the board at least 60 percent of all that we spend on Ukraine is spent in the United States of America, creating jobs.
The Congresswoman spelled out very clearly the ridiculous notion that Ukraine should trust us--the Russians after the Budapest Agreement.
Ukraine has been treated with great disrespect.
What we should be doing in this House, which has overwhelming bipartisan support in support of the people of Ukraine, is to get some more people to sign the discharge petition.

I thank Congresswoman Kaptur for her relentless, persistent, dissatisfied advocacy for Ukraine and the fact is we know, those of us who have visited there: If Putin takes Ukraine, what country is next?
The only person who trusted Putin was President Trump.
I know I had a picture, coming out of one of his Cabinet meetings, I pointed to the President, and I said: I am leaving this meeting because, Mr. President, with you, all roads lead to Putin.
They say Putin is the richest man in the world.
Give up your nuclear weapons, and we will come to your aid, should you need that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ROB AND MICHELE REINER TRIBUTE
statements.title: ROB AND MICHELE REINER TRIBUTE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I will provide a fuller statement for the record of the great life achievements and beautiful, beautiful love of community of Rob and Michele Reiner.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SHAMEFUL HERNANDEZ PARDON
statements.title: SHAMEFUL HERNANDEZ PARDON
sentences: Hernandez once boasted at a meeting of narcotraffickers that ``together they were going to shove the drugs right up the noses of the gringos.'' What message does pardoning this criminal send to parents who have lost children to narcotics, to law enforcement officers risking everything to stop the flow of deadly drugs?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Did any one of them vote to eliminate a need for preexisting conditions in healthcare?
Did any one of them vote for the Affordable Care Act, which, Mr. Speaker, you can tell them was paid for?

If your wife has breast cancer, you have big bills to pay because they want to take away healthcare, whether it is Medicaid to tens of millions of people, half a trillion dollars for Medicare for seniors and people with disabilities, and millions of dollars added to the cost for families to access the Affordable Care Act.

As a grandmother and mother, how about the President of the United States having a Halloween party on Halloween night and saying to the Supreme Court: Please don't make me feed the children or the poor people in our country.
Mr. Speaker, going to the Supreme Court for that means that ``cruelty'' has not even come close to the word that is needed for that kind of behavior.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FEDERAL RESERVE INDEPENDENCE
statements.title: FEDERAL RESERVE INDEPENDENCE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of one of the bedrock principles of our economy: the independence of the Federal Reserve Board.

It was doing so because of--well, I have written about it in my book, and I won't go through the whole thing right now--what was happening terribly in the financial system by the banks and financial institutions.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELATING TO CONSIDERATION OF THE SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 4, RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RELATING TO CONSIDERATION OF THE SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 4, RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: I am talking about what is happening in this Rescissions Act.
He warned that cutting State Department USAID will put every American at risk.
The dismissal of highly trained diplomats at the State Department and the dismantling of USAID will jeopardize national security and make the military's job much more difficult.
Our national security has never depended on military strength alone; rather, it relies on collaboration with a strong Foreign Service and diplomatic corps,'' and I am adding with our USAID.

In this bill, over $8 billion is taken away from what we do to alleviate poverty in the world, to lessen things like HIV and AIDS and other diseases, which have an impact on global health, by stopping the funding for the World Health Organization.
Mr. Speaker, I urge everyone to vote ``no'' on this and understand what this is.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LAYOFFS AT THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION
statements.title: LAYOFFS AT THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the Supreme Court's ridiculous decision this week to allow the President to proceed with mass layoffs at the Department of Education is a grave blow to the rule of law and defies congressional authority.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Is it beautiful to do this to give tax cuts to billionaires in our country?
Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: They are the biggest spending in this bill, to the tune of $5 trillion added to the national debt to give tax cuts to the wealthiest people in the country at the expense of feeding our children, healthcare for our people, and the education of our children.
The Biblical power to cure that science provides for us is cut in this bill to spend $5 trillion for the wealthiest people in America.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Let's just talk about work requirements for a moment.
One of them said: If I have a work requirement to have Medicaid, this is what it means to me.
If my child is sick, I can't go to work because I can't afford childcare.
What I have to do is put my child on a schoolbus even though my child is sick, and I have to go to work to have Medicaid.
I will just recall for you a conversation I had with some moms.
If I miss work, I will miss pay, and I can't afford to miss the pay.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS WOMEN AND FAMILIES
sentences: Republicans are slashing $300 billion--that is b, billion dollars-- from SNAP, in addition to cutting $700 billion from Medicaid.
That is $1 trillion in cruel cuts from our Nation's children in order to give tax cuts to billionaires.
Hands off our Medicaid, and hands off our SNAP. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS EVERYONE
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS EVERYONE
sentences: When I hear them talk about cutting over $700 billion in Medicaid and that it is just waste, fraud, and abuse, this beautiful child is not waste, fraud, and abuse.
This Special Order comes together to shine a bright light on the Republican plan to fund tax breaks for billionaires by making huge cuts to Medicaid.
The fact is they will still with their tax bill add nearly $4 trillion to the national debt to cover their tax break for the wealthiest people in our country.
This is Robin Hood in reverse, taking resources from where it is most needed, from people who need it most, and giving it to those who need it less, the billionaires in America.

When President Johnson signed Medicare and Medicaid into law, he traveled to Independence, Missouri, to be in the presence of former President Truman who had worked on this when he was President, but it came to fruition under President Johnson.

He reminded the American people of a shared tradition: ``Never to be indifferent toward despair. . . . never to turn away from helplessness. . . . never to ignore or spurn those who suffer untended in a land that is bursting with abundance.'' Indeed, Medicaid saves lives and is a pillar of health, security, and justice for tens of millions of Americans.
People often think of Medicaid as healthcare for poor children, and that would be justification enough, healthcare for poor children.
They get that largely through Medicaid.
The Republicans' devastating budget plan would push about 14 million Medicaid recipients off lifesaving healthcare and leave countless vulnerable families exposed to catastrophic medical bills.

Working families and children from low-income households would face ruinous consequences as would rural hospitals--as the distinguished Congresswoman has mentioned--families seeking opioid addiction treatment for their loved ones, and middle-class Americans with long- term care needs.
California Medical Association issued the following statement regarding House Republicans' proposed cuts in Medicaid: ``The latest Federal proposal to gut Medicaid is reckless.

Physicians and hospitals will be pushed to the brink, forced to close their doors and unable to continue care for their patients.'' Mr. Speaker, that is because when this funding leaves those rural hospitals, then not only do the Medicaid patients lose, but all the patients in that rural area lose. ``These would be the largest Medicaid cuts in history and will leave veterans, seniors, the disabled, children and working families without healthcare coverage''--this is as the distinguished physician colleague has said--``making emergency rooms the only point of care for millions of people.
My guest at the President's State of the Union Address to Congress was Elena Hung, mother of Xiomara, a courageous Little Lobbyist, who is 11 years old.
Medicaid has helped Xiomara receive the therapies she needs to catch up with her developmental milestones, including physical therapy, occupational therapy, feeding therapy, and speech therapy.
However, these very lifelines, including Medicaid and more, are what Republicans are working to destroy to fund tax cuts for billionaires.
That includes the Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.
We will always fight for Medicaid.
They are still adding nearly $4 trillion to the national budget to give tax breaks to their wealthy billionaire friends.
When the Republicans passed that bill and the President signed it into law, 83 percent of the benefits went to the top 1 percent, adding $2 trillion to the national debt.

They are doubling down on that, adding almost $4 trillion to the national debt and saying: We have got to give all this money to billionaires and call children waste, fraud, and abuse in our Medicaid system.
I hope their constituents will call them, because these Medicaid people are in Republican districts.
One of our colleagues in California has, out of all of our constituents, he has nearly 500,000 people on Medicaid.

There was one time when Medicaid first began that one of the people who was starting community health centers around the country insisted-- insisted--with the Federal Government that food be counted as medicine because it is about health.

We are behind the rest of them in many of these regards when we have to take food out of the mouths of babies to say that we are going to give a tax cut to the wealthiest, but we just really are taking food out of the mouths of babies because we don't want to feed them.
That is what this is about, $1 trillion: $700 billion or more for Medicaid and $300 billion for SNAP.
We will always work to strengthen pillars of health and financial security in America.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 60, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE NATIONAL PARK SERVICE RELATING TO "GLEN CANYON NAT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 60, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE NATIONAL PARK SERVICE RELATING TO "GLEN CANYON NATIONAL RECREATION AREA: MOTOR...
sentences: Don't say clean air for our children to breathe is too expensive for us after all the things that the President has done to make things more expensive in our country.
The illegal attack on the vital clean air protection set by California would choke our communities with smog.

The gentleman even referenced it in his comments, and we will relentlessly defend our State's right to protect the air our children breathe with robust fuel economy and pollution standards when Federal standards fall short.

With these resolutions, Republicans are exposing their cynical, special-interest agenda that endangers public health in every community in our country by dismantling our protections for clean air, clean air for our children to breathe.
Today, they want us to favor big polluters over clean air for our children to breathe.
Democrats will never stop fighting to defend lifesaving protections for America's clean air.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to all of the Republican resolutions on the floor today, one of which takes away the right of California or any State to protect residents from dangerous pollution.
For the children, Mr. Speaker, I urge a strong ``no'' on this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 25, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE RELATING TO "GROSS PROCEE
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 25, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE RELATING TO "GROSS PROCEEDS REPORTING BY BROKERS THAT...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, today Republicans will vote to pass a continuing resolution that hollows out our Nation's commitment to the health, education, and economic security of America's working families.

Instead of working constructively in a bipartisan way to meet the needs of the American people, Republicans are trying to starve the domestic budget with a partisan bill--I am going to focus on veterans here--that cuts nearly $23 billion in veterans' benefits in addition to slashing even more money from healthcare and affordable housing.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``no'' on this betrayal of our veterans, and I urge my Republican colleagues to join Democrats at the negotiating table to get serious about the peoples' business.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 20, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVAT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.J. RES. 20, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY RELATING TO "ENERGY CONSERVATION PROGRAM: ENERGY CONSERVATION...
sentences: The last time the Republicans had a majority in the House and Senate and President Trump in the White House, they passed a terrible bill that was a tax cut for the rich that gave 83 percent of the benefits to the wealthiest people, the top 1 percent in our country, and added $2 trillion to the national debt.
This year, they are doubling down on that, $4 trillion to the national debt, and they call that fiscal sanity.
They are doing it by steering taxpayer dollars from Medicaid to give additional tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations.
People think of Medicaid sometimes as a poor children's program, and that would be sufficient justification for it all, but it is a middle- income benefit.
Seniors who need long-term healthcare need Medicaid.
Mr. Speaker, indeed a vote for this budget is a vote against Medicaid, ripping away healthcare from children, people with disabilities, and seniors.
They do that with glee while President Trump and congressional Republicans are choosing to protect billionaires, by the way, who benefit from Medicaid with people cleaning their homes.
We are united in our commitment to work for working families.
That is why I urge a ``no'' vote on this extreme measure, and I thank the distinguished chairman for his leadership.
